_comment: Built-in pack for CSIR NET (27 November 2026), from the team's CSIR NET notes. It offers the typeset notes in the B.Sc. template (note_studio/typeset). branding.from_pdf: each lecture PDF's own running header (left: the name, e.g. 'CSIR NET - Life Sciences'; right: e.g. 'Unit 1: Biochemistry') and its header logo go on the notes (typeset/source_brand.py); the words below are used only when a PDF has no header. pw_logo false: no PW logo when a PDF has no logo (Settings -> Categories can add it).
label: CSIR NET
summary: CSIR NET notes in the B.Sc. template; each lecture PDF's own header name and logo go on the notes.
